diagram_math_checks.result: Six nodes are G_n^pure, PB_n, G_n, B_n^conf, and two copies of S_n, all at the fixed Q/[Q]. Seven arrows have the stated domains/codomains: Psi, inclusion, p_*, Phi, pi_geo, pi_conf, and id. p_* is drawn to B_n^conf, with image ker(pi_conf), not as a surjection onto all B_n^conf.
diagram_math_checks.basis: Assigned Statement, L1–L4 and proof 1.1–1.3; pure-corollary proof 3.1.

diagram_math_checks.result: p_* composed with Psi equals Phi composed with the inclusion of G_n^pure. This follows from Psi=p_*^{-1} composed with the restriction of Phi onto the kernel; both horizontal arrows are group isomorphisms.
diagram_math_checks.basis: Assigned proof 1.2, L2–L3; pure-corollary proof 4.1 computes p_*((iota^F_*[z_beta])^{-1})=(iota^C_*[S(beta)])^{-1}.

diagram_math_checks.result: pi_conf composed with Phi equals id composed with pi_geo. Raw slicing has inverse geometric endpoint monodromy, so inverse-loop slicing restores exactly pi_geo; no reversed permutation is drawn.
diagram_math_checks.basis: Assigned proof 1.3 and L4; endpoint proposition proof 1.1–2.1, with terminal strand j at q_{pi_geo(beta)(j)}.

diagram_math_checks.check: Height, strands, loops and multiplication order
diagram_math_checks.result: Remarks correctly read strand graphs (z_j(t),t) from height 0 to 1, giving S(beta)(t)=[(z_1(t),...,z_n(t))]. Only for pure braids is the ordered tuple a loop at Q. Beta below gamma in gamma star beta gives S(beta) first and S(gamma) second; inversion changes (ba)^{-1} to a^{-1}b^{-1}, so Phi and Psi are homomorphisms. No strand crossing or crossing sign is asserted by the group-map figure.
diagram_math_checks.basis: Geometric-braid definition; stacking lemma proof 1.1–3.1; unordered theorem proof 2.1–3.1 and pure-corollary proof 5.1.

diagram_math_checks.result: For n=0 and n=1 the stated groups/maps degenerate as in proof 2.1; diagram adds no nontrivial permutation or strand assumption. The original four-step proof is unchanged and independent of the illustration.
